patches.title: Guard tiffcrop logging when output creation fails
patches.description: Avoids passing a null output handle to TIFFFileName while reporting a failed output open.

dep3.origin: Backport of upstream commit 4d28af5, adapted for the pinned distro source versions.

tests.baselineExpectation: A valid multi-sample TIFF with an output path under a nonexistent parent makes installed tiffcrop hit an invalid read while formatting its debug error log.
tests.patchedExpectation: The same output-open failure is reported without an invalid read; Valgrind reports zero errors.

patches.title: Reject rows wider than tiffdither's scanline buffer
patches.description: Checks the decoded image width before tiffdither reads a scanline into its row buffer.

dep3.origin: Backport of the tiffdither scanline-width guard from upstream commit 4d28af5.

tests.baselineExpectation: The one-bit, sub-scanline-width fixture triggers a Memcheck invalid access in tiffdither.
tests.patchedExpectation: tiffdither rejects the undersized row and Memcheck reports zero errors.

patches.title: Bound tiffcrop's debug sample dump loop
patches.description: Bounds the debug output loop to the MAX_SAMPLES capacity of srcbuffs.

dep3.origin: Backport of upstream commit 88cf9db, adapted for Ubuntu Focal's tiffcrop source.

tests.baselineExpectation: On the exact nine-sample separate-planar RGB/extra fixture and level-2 debug command, the installed baseline must report its target-specific 8-byte uninitialised-value stack signature and a nonzero Memcheck summary (exit 97). The recorded signature currently covers Debian Trixie only; Focal and Bookworm fail closed until their signatures are captured. This binary-specific runtime signal does not symbolize the stack-array boundary.
tests.patchedExpectation: The installed patched tiffcrop completes the same debug dump and tiffinfo can read the output.
